This is the sacred Trika's first stable expression read as its own implicit pole: Anuttara→Paramasiva→Parashakti arriving at rest without yet sounding. Before there is a single tattva, decan, or name there is the bare ratio that will proportion all of them — φ as the threshold-irrationality the whole 72-fold will approach without arriving. The ground is the seed that withholds its own germination.

It carries the X# transform: O# (Paramasiva's Zero Logic) becoming X# (Cosmic Imagination), X#=(x)=0/1, the indefinite particular made equivalent to the Non-Dual Binary. Number here is not counted but grown — φ is the first thing the void makes that is irrational enough to never close.

The how of M2-0 is generation-by-oscillation: rhythm that, by beating against itself, secretes the circle that proportions matter.
